name: AL1-L3
description: AL1-L3, nicknamed "Allie," was a protocol droid that served in the administrative center of the Pyke Syndicate's spice mines on the planet Kessel. After witnessing a droid revolution sparked by the droid L3-37 in 10 BBY, AL1-L3 saw a glimpse of independence that survived in the back of her processors when she was later scrapped and recycled.
